input.query: SELECT channel, months_since_activation, n_observable, SUM(avg_margin_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY months_since_activation ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_margin_eur, MAX(months_since_activation) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS max_observed_month, MAX(cac_eur) AS cac_eur FROM agg_unit_economics WHERE lower(channel) LIKE '%social%' GROUP BY channel, months_since_activation, n_observable, avg_margin_eur ORDER BY channel, months_since_activation DESC LIMIT 1
